note: Site 063 on Hoofnagle Road just north of Hunter Road: a short (about 30 ft) gravel back-in beside the road under full tree cover, one camping unit; DCNR's map layer describes it as suitable for a small trailer or camper. Fire ring and picnic table, nothing else. About 3.6 miles of Hunter Road from Weikert Road. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), $10/$15 + $6.50, max vehicle 25 ft, 30-ft back-in gravel spur graded slight, 14-ft clearance, shaded. Imagery rendered but is leaf-on closed canopy: no pad or spur visible, so the spur could not be measured. Pin is on the ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS point, 28 m from Hoofnagle Road in OSM; 3DEP shows pin and road level (551 m). No NHD flowline within 200 m.
flags: THIN MARGIN: max vehicle length 25 ft with a 30-ft driveway and a 40 x 40 ft site; DCNR GIS says TrailerAccess 'Yes', 'Just north of Hunter Road. Suitable for small trailer or camper.' A 23-ft rig fits the posted figure by 2 ft. The spur could NOT be measured on imagery (closed canopy), so the fit rests on the booking page alone.
No 'RV Site' among the equipment categories on any Bald Eagle site page in this entry ('Tent Site, Trailer Site'): by the brief that is keep, flagged.
Forest-wide 4WD/high-clearance line on the site page; nothing singles out Hoofnagle or Hunter Road. Road surface and weight limits unread (Overpass did not answer).
